text:
anna: Kicking off tenant_tags backfill on prod shard-3 now. deploybot has the lease. If locks get bad we'll abort and pin the release. @jaden @leo please monitor.

deploybot: Lease acquired by deployer-3 for backfill job #btf-421. ETA ~12m. Will post a stall alert if long-held locks > 2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jaden: Saw a spike on tx latency at start, 40ms -> 220ms on p99. Noticed a few row-level waits. Watching.

leo: Adding DB-side watch: pg_stat_activity + blocking_pids tailing. If any lock > 3s on user_events we should abort. Agree with pin plan.

ops-bot: Auto-safemode configured: if avg lock_time > 5s over 1m window, mark backfill for manual abort and notify #eng-oncall.

anna: Ack. Abort command is:
```
./deploybot abort --lease deployer-3 --reason "lock contention > threshold" --pin v2.14.1
```
We'll also create a release notes entry: "Backfill attempted on prod; aborted due to lock contention; rescheduled." I'll draft it after abort.

jaden: Lock pileup trending up. Two sessions in WAITING for 9s. I'm in the DB console now.

deploybot: Stall alert: backfill job #btf-421 stalled at 00:07:32. long_lock_count=2. Preparing to pause if manual override not seen in 1m.

leo: I'm going to gracefully stop the backfill worker on shard-3 to avoid cascading timeouts. Doing that now.

anna: Stopping worker acknowledged. issuing abort now.

deploybot: Abort complete. Lease released. Backfill job #btf-421 status=ABORTED. Pin applied: deployed services pinned to v2.14.1 for the next deployment window.

ops-bot: Notifying oncall and updating incident tracker: https://internal/incidents/INC-2026-0421 .

jaden: I've collected traces + `pg_stat_activity` snapshot and uploaded to the runbook. Will do a quick root-cause triage and propose a safer chunk size + rate for retry.

anna: Thanks. Tentative plan: reschedule full retry in maintenance window Sat 03:00-06:00 UTC, with chunk_size=500 and worker concurrency=2. We'll add rollback/runbook notes in release-notes before unpin. :white_check_mark:
